avg_days_in_stage._comment: Average days-in-stage for currently OPEN opportunities only, from lastStageChangeAt to now. 0b. Far Out (Cold) and 1b. Postponed are inflated by a long-tail legacy backlog (see workflow_drift_backlog).

reporting.store_pipeline_note: STORE: Material Pipeline has 63 opportunities lifetime (48 open, 17 won, 4 lost, 2 abandoned split across its own +3d/+8d/manual stages -- see store_pipeline_stage_counts); this is retail material sales (lightspeed POS-driven), distinct from project work. No opportunity moves or closes in this pipeline in the last 24h.

meeting_window_summary._comment: median_days_entry_to_appointment and median_effective_window_days computed from a sample of the 7 most-overdue open Meeting-Scheduled records (Kash, Sonny, Nirav, Firoz, Imtiaz, Ben, Maxine) since appointment date isn't a queryable opportunity field and pulling it for all 49 would require per-contact conversation review. In this sample, appointments consumed only 0.6-13 days of the 30-day window (median 2.7) -- none had the window structurally expired by a far-out booking. The gap is entirely the missing follow-up sequence, not booking lead time: all 7 have sat 97-138 days since their actual visit. See items ghl-drift-meeting_no_followup-* .

workflow_drift_backlog._comment: Account-wide totals behind each drift type, most of which is legacy (not new today) and NOT individually itemized in workflow_drift[] below -- only the most acute/recently-crossed instances are itemized there. This reconciles the itemized counts back to the true account-wide scale, same spirit as reporting.exclusions.
workflow_drift_backlog.stale_approaching_note: 146 open opportunities (Lead Qualification + Sales pipelines) have crossed >=75% of their stage's stale threshold without a stale_lead tag; 106 of those are already 2x+ their threshold (long-dormant legacy records, several sharing an identical days-in-stage figure suggesting a bulk import/migration rather than organic staleness). workflow_drift_backlog.abandonment_next_note: 10 open opportunities outside the Meeting-Scheduled stage already carry stale_lead and are at or past their 2x auto-abandon point; 6 are itemized (3 genuinely approaching, 3 flagship examples of records far past 2x that are still status=open, suggesting the auto-abandon action isn't always firing).
